name: code2pdf
description: Print source code as a PDF made for reading: a contents page, syntax highlighting, real line numbers and a bookmark per file. Print a folder, chosen files, a selection, or what changed in git with the changed lines marked.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: code2pdf runs git in the workspace, and a repository's git settings can run programs.

virtualWorkspaces.description: code2pdf reads the files from disk.

commands.title: Choose Files and Print to PDF…
Print All Src File to A Single PDF (old name)

code2pdf.outputFolder.markdownDescription: Folder to save PDFs in without asking, such as `~/Documents/printouts`. Leave empty to choose where to save each PDF. A relative path is relative to the workspace folder.

enumDescriptions: Open the PDF in your computer's PDF viewer
Open the PDF in a VS Code tab (needs a PDF viewer extension)
Don't open it; show where it was saved
code2pdf.openWith.description: What to do with a PDF once it's made.

code2pdf.theme.markdownDescription: Colour theme: `paper` (the default), `mono` (black and white, for printers), or the name of any Pygments style, such as `github-dark` or `solarized-light`. Run `code2pdf --list-themes` for the full list.

code2pdf.include.markdownDescription: Globs to add when printing a folder, for files the default selection leaves out: data files such as `*.json`, hidden folders such as `.github`, or skipped folders such as `vendor/mylib`. Passed to code2pdf as `--include`.

code2pdf.exclude.markdownDescription: Globs to leave out when printing a folder or changes, such as `tests`, `*_test.go` or `docs/**/*.md`. Without `/` a glob matches names at any depth; with `/` it matches the path from the folder. Passed to code2pdf as `--exclude`.

code2pdf.executable.markdownDescription: Path to the `code2pdf` command. Leave empty to find it on your `PATH` and in the usual install folders.

code2pdf.blacklisted_folders.markdownDeprecationMessage: Replaced by `#code2pdf.exclude#`. A value you set here is still used.

code2pdf.blacklisted_folder_pattern.markdownDeprecationMessage: Replaced by `#code2pdf.exclude#`. A value you set here is still used.
code2pdf.blacklisted_folder_pattern.description: A pattern for folders to skip.

code2pdf.whitelisted_file_extensions.markdownDeprecationMessage: No longer needed: code2pdf now includes common source code by default. A value you set here still limits printing to these extensions.
code2pdf.whitelisted_file_extensions.description: The only file extensions to print.

code2pdf.whitelisted_file_names.markdownDeprecationMessage: Replaced by `#code2pdf.include#`. A value you set here is still used.
code2pdf.whitelisted_file_names.description: File names to include as well.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
